note: Brand intelligence kits captured from a brand's own intelligence hub. When a plan is generated for a brand with a kit, the agents ground the plan in this REAL brand content -- story, message hierarchy, claims, guardrails, concepts, personas, live market signals -- instead of synthesizing placeholders. Content below was captured verbatim from the Nuvexa brand hub (https://commongoods.netlify.app/) on 2026-07-11. Nuvexa/Ligead Sciences is a fictional demo brand.

Nuvexa.core_claim: The complete solution for every HIV-1 patient.

message_hierarchy.claim: 82% VS at 240 weeks with zero treatment-emergent resistance
message_hierarchy.evidence: Studies 1489/1490 240-week pooled: 82% HIV-1 RNA <50 c/mL · zero treatment-emergent resistance across all studies (5yr)

message_hierarchy.claim: Naive · Switch · M184V/I — one STR for all patients
message_hierarchy.evidence: Study 1844: ≥97% VS on switch · Study 4030: active against M184V/I (FDA Feb 2024, NEJM publication Q3 2025)

message_hierarchy.claim: 49/50 state ADAP coverage, OptumRx Tier 2 Preferred, $0 co-pay
message_hierarchy.evidence: Ligead Advancing Access®: $0 co-pay commercially insured · ADAP 49/50 states · FRM network in all 50 states · 340B / Ryan White Part B

Nuvexa.approved_indication: Nuvexa® (bictegravir 50 mg / emtricitabine 200 mg / tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg) is indicated as a complete regimen for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adults and pediatric patients weighing at least 25 kg who have no antiretroviral treatment history or to replace the current antiretroviral regimen in those who are virologically stable (HIV-1 RNA <50 copies/mL) on a stable antiretroviral regimen with no history of treatment failure and no known substitutions associated with resistance to the individual components. Also indicated in HIV-1 infected adults with documented M184V or M184I substitution.
Nuvexa.safety_reference: Warnings: New onset or worsening renal impairment (monitor CrCl, serum phosphorus); Lactic acidosis / severe hepatomegaly; Immune reconstitution syndrome. Adverse Reactions (>5%): Diarrhoea, nausea, headache, fatigue. Interactions: Strong inducers of UGT1A1/CYP3A may decrease bictegravir concentrations. Refer to full prescribing information.

clinical_data.context: N=1,847 · VS parity in Black adults

dos.text: Always anchor claims to the specific study name (e.g. "Studies 1489/1490") — not generic "data"
Attribute every statistic: VS rate, resistance rate, duration
Use "Nuvexa®" with ® on first mention in any piece — headline and body
Capitalise "Power of Complete™" with ™ every use
Use the coral mark on white or navy backgrounds only
Maintain minimum clear space of 1× mark width on all sides
Include fair balance / Important Safety Information on all promotional materials
Submit all new materials through MLR before distribution
Write in a confident, evidence-led register — let data create urgency
Position HCP as expert partner, not passive recipient
Always include Ligead Advancing Access® reference when discussing co-pay or coverage
Connect access messaging to real patient impact, not just programme mechanics

donts.text: Do not use "cure," "eliminate," or "best-in-class" without direct head-to-head citation
Do not reference competitor brand names in promotional materials
Do not use ® in body copy — first mention in headlines only
Do not use patient testimonials without MLR approval and fair balance
Do not recolour the logo mark or wordmark
Do not stretch, distort, or apply drop shadows to the logo
Do not distribute any materials before MLR clearance
Do not omit fair balance — even in digital/social abbreviated formats
Do not round or approximate clinical data figures
Do not extrapolate from study populations to unapproved populations
Do not guarantee coverage or reimbursement to any HCP or patient
Do not use ADAP/Ryan White figures without current-year verification

concepts.name: Power of Complete™
concepts.description: FY2025 master campaign platform. One message, every channel, every patient type — clinical durability, access, and versatility woven into a single brand promise.

concepts.name: The Mutation Advantage™
concepts.description: When your patient has M184V/I, most STRs give up. Nuvexa® doesn't. FDA-approved, Study 4030-backed activation for the HCPs who still have patients with mutations on their charts.

concepts.name: BRAAVE™ — Equal Outcomes
concepts.description: Real-world proof that Nuvexa® works as well for Black adults as it does in clinical trials. Community-first storytelling, RWE backbone. Because equal treatment should produce equal results.

concepts.name: Built to Last™
concepts.description: Five years. Zero resistance. The conversation that opens doors with the HCPs who've been burned before. Long-term durability isn't a promise — it's a track record.

concepts.name: Stay Simple™
concepts.description: A monthly injection sounds like freedom — until you factor in the FQHC schedule, the cold chain, the admin. One pill a day, on your terms, with nothing to prove. That's freedom.

concepts.name: The Smarter Foundation™
concepts.description: Your patients are worrying about their bones and kidneys. Give their HCPs something to say. TAF-based regimen, renal and bone safety data, no compromise on suppression.

concepts.name: Ligead Advancing Access®
concepts.description: The access infrastructure behind the brand. $0 co-pay, 49-state ADAP coverage, FRM network. The programme that means a prescription actually gets filled.

concepts.name: Complete Confidence
concepts.description: Legacy HCP education platform (FY2022–2023). Superseded by Power of Complete™. Materials in sunset — Q2 2025 distribution end date.

concepts.name: Own the STR
concepts.description: Legacy category-leadership concept (FY2021). First-mover STR positioning, pre-Power of Complete™ era. Archived.

concepts.name: The Connected Journey™
concepts.description: Emerging. Every digital touchpoint a patient hits — from diagnosis search to refill reminder — mapped, owned, and optimised. Piloting in 3 DMAs, full rollout Q4.

concepts.name: Evidence On Demand™
concepts.description: NuvexaHCP.com reimagined as a live intelligence platform. M184V/I traffic +280% post-CROI. Q3 refresh converting intent into action — detail requests, MSL scheduling, rep follow-up.

concepts.name: Signal to Story™
concepts.description: Emerging. Real-time MSL briefing auto-generated from market signals and persona appetite scores minutes before an HCP interaction. The brief that writes itself.
